respec_acallaid.name: A Call For Aid
respec_acallaid.description: Once per session, the character may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm check. On success, the character reveals how a previously unknown call for aid has a meaningful impact on the scene. If the check fails and generates a [DE] result, however, the GM may decide that the character's ineffective plea either puts them in further danger, or the intended ally is apprehended when answering the call.

respec_accordingdesign.name: According to My Design
respec_accordingdesign.description: Once per session after a check the character or an ally within medium range makes results in [DE], suffer 4 strain to add [TR] to that check. The player should establish how they planned for exactly this eventuality.

respec_actilist.name: Active Listener
respec_actilist.description: When targeted by an opposed social check, may suffer 2 strain to oppose the check with Perception (Cunning) instead of Cool or Discipline.

respec_actlisimp.name: Active Listener (Improved)
respec_actlisimp.description: When using Active Listener, may also suffer strain up to ranks of Perception to add that many [SE] to the check.

respec_alwaprep.name: Always Prepared
respec_alwaprep.description: Once per session, as an incidental, produce a previously undocumented piece of personal equipment or weapon, with a rarity no greater than 4, as if a Destiny Point was spent. If producing a weapon, it also has the Limited Ammo 1 quality.

respec_ambusher.name: Ambusher
respec_ambusher.description: Once per round when benefiting from cover or concealment, may make the Ambusher maneuver. Add damage equal to the character's ranks in Stealth skill to one hit of the next successful non-starship/vehicle combat check made against a target within Medium range before the end of their turn.

respec_ancoimp.name: Animal Companion (Improved)
respec_ancoimp.description: Animal Companion may now be no larger than Silhouette 3. Attacks targeting an Animal Companion treat their critical rating as 1 higher.

respec_animcomp.name: Animal Companion
respec_animcomp.description:
Choose an animal no larger than Silhouette 2 to be an Animal Companion. Upgrade all checks made to soothe or heal them once.
If the Animal Companion ever dies or becomes lost, the character may work with the Game Master to choose a new one and determine the bonding process to make them the character’s Animal Companion.

respec_armyofone.name: Army of One
respec_armyofone.description: Once per encounter after inflicting a critical injury or incapacitating a foe, the character may spend a Destiny Point to immediately make an attack against a different foe within range of an equipped weapon.

respec_assetacquired.name: Asset Acquired
respec_assetacquired.description: Once per session, spend [AD][AD][AD] from a Streetwise or Social check made to gather information to increase the members within an intelligence network or the scope of a contact network once until the end of session.

respec_attadelt.name: Attack Pattern Delta
respec_attadelt.description: May make an Average ([DI][DI]) Leadership check to have other allied vehicles up to ranks of Leadership within close range benefit from the character's ranks of Defensive Driving.

respec_attvec.name: Attack Vector
respec_attvec.description: Once per encounter, may Make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check to identify a weak point in an enemy vehicle or structure. On success, aim maneuvers made to target it before the end of the character’s next turn add [SU] in addition to normal effects.

respec_badmotimp.name: Bad Motivator (Improved)
respec_badmotimp.description: Once per session when taking the Bad Motivator action, the character may choose a trigger or circumstance under which the device will fail, rather than it failing immediately. The device functions normally until that trigger occurs.

respec_barghunt.name: Bargain Hunter
respec_barghunt.description: When the character makes a check to purchase or sell goods or services, they add [BO] or remove [SE] equal to their ranks of Bargain Hunter.

respec_bedsidemanner.name: Bedside Manners
respec_bedsidemanner.description: Add [AD][AD] to social checks the character makes against targets they have medically treated this encounter, or [SU][TH][TH] against those they have tortured, physically or otherwise.

respec_blackout.name: Blackout
respec_blackout.description: Once per encounter, make a Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Computers check to disrupt enemy communications. Add [SE] to all checks made by opposing forces for rounds equal to [SU]. Spend [AD][AD][AD] to add [FA] to the next check each foe makes.

respec_blackoutimp.name: Blackout (Improved)
respec_blackoutimp.description: Decrease the difficulty of Blackout to Hard ([DI][DI][DI]). Additionally, spend [TR] to keep an enemy leader from upgrading the next ability or difficulty of the next Mass Combat check made this encounter.

respec_blendingin.name: Blending In
respec_blendingin.description: Suffer 2 strain to make a Stealth check with Cunning instead of Agility.

respec_bolster.name: Bolster
respec_bolster.description: As a maneuver, the character may remove [SE] per rank of Bolster imposed by a single environmental circumstance from all actions they make this encounter. This may be used multiple times to remove setbacks imposed by additional environmental circumstances.

respec_bolstimp.name: Bolster (Improved)
respec_bolstimp.description: The benefits of the Bolster maneuver apply to all allies within short range as long as they remain within short range of the character.

respec_breoff.name: Break Off
respec_breoff.description: Once per encounter, when an allied vehicle within close range becomes the target of an attack, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Vigilance check to become the target of the attack. The character may spend [AD][AD] to upgrade the difficulty of the attack once, and may spend [TR] to have the original defender of the attack Gain The Advantage on the attacker.

respec_brthin.name: Break Them In
respec_brthin.description: Make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Athletics check to train one or more animals, upgrading the difficulty by the Animal’s Willpower. On success, one animal gains Trained Mount 1 until the end of the session, plus 1 animal per additional [SU][SU].

respec_bulwark.name: Got You Covered
respec_bulwark.description: If the character has attacked this round, allies within short range increase their Ranged defense by 1.

respec_bypsecimp.name: Bypass Security (Improved)*
respec_bypsecimp.description: May spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from checks to unlock doors or disable a security device to add [BO] equal to ranks of Bypass Security to similar checks in the same system or location this session.

respec_cannib.name: Cannibalize*
respec_cannib.description: Once per encounter, the character may scrap an existing piece of similar gear to add [SU] to a check to create, improve or repair another piece of gear, mechanical object, starship, or vehicle.

respec_ceasfire.name: Ceasefire
respec_ceasfire.description: Once per session, when leading armed conflict or mass combat, may make an opposed Negotiation vs Cool check targeting the opposing leader. On success, the leaders in the conflict agree to pause hostilities. Add [DE] to first combat check made by an involved character until the end of the following round. Spend [AD][AD][AD] to extend the Ceasefire an additional round, and spend [TR] to exempt allied characters from the effect.

respec_codeimpr.name: Codebreaker (Improved)
respec_codeimpr.description: Once per session, may choose a faction or group and make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers check to gain insight on their plans or communications. On success, may add [FA] equal to ranks of Codebreaker to one check made by that group this session.

respec_collateraldamage.name: Collateral Damage
respec_collateraldamage.description: Once per encounter after they miss an attack with an explosive or ordinance weapon, the character may spend a Destiny Point to reroll the attack against a different target within range. If the attack has the Guided quality and generated at least two uncancelled [AD] or a [TR], they may activate this incidental without spending a Destiny Point.

respec_combarms.name: Combined Arms
respec_combarms.description: Allied characters within short range of a vehicle piloted by the character treat their ranged defense as equal to the highest defense zone of that vehicle.

respec_compromisedre.name: Compromised
respec_compromisedre.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion or Deception check. On a success, a foe is convinced the character has compromising evidence, and will assist the character for the rest of the encounter, per GM discretion. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have the foe assist the character for the rest of the session, instead.

respec_construc.name: Constructor
respec_construc.description: When constructing bases, defenses, positions, or other similar combat engineering projects, add [BO] or remove [SE] per rank of Constructor.

respec_corsliimp.name: Corellian Slip (Improved)
respec_corsliimp.description: Spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from attacks targeting the character or an ally within close range benefitting from Evasive Maneuvers to inflict a hit on the attacker.

respec_coumobimp.name: Counter-Mobility (Improved)
respec_coumobimp.description: Add [TH] to checks made by foes in the chosen approach. May spend [TH][TH][TH] from a foe’s check to immobilize them for rounds equal to characters ranks of Survival, or cause a minor collision.

respec_counmobi.name: Counter-Mobility
respec_counmobi.description: While defending a position, the character may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check. On [SU], foes treat an approach to this position out to extreme range as difficult terrain. Spend [AD][AD][AD] to increase range to planetary close.

respec_counoffe.name: Counteroffensive
respec_counoffe.description: Once per round, may spend [TH][TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from a foe’s combat or Leadership check to make a Leadership Check as an out-of-turn incidental.

respec_counterint.name: Counter-Intelligence
respec_counterint.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge Warfare check to disseminate false military info. On success, may add [DE] to a relevant check made by the misled faction before the end of this session. The character must establish how the information gets to said enemy.

respec_crashthro.name: Crash Through
respec_crashthro.description: When instigating a collision with another vehicle, add +10 for each point of Armor of the character’s vehicle to the other vehicle’s resulting critical hit.

respec_dangdev.name: Dangerous Development*
respec_dangdev.description: When making a check to improve or craft an item, may suffer 2 strain and upgrade the check once. On [SU], may add a single permanent improvement to the item.

respec_dangerclose.name: Danger Close
respec_dangerclose.description: When the character engages a foe during combat, that foe adds [FA] to their next check.

respec_dangercloseimp.name: Danger Close (Improved)
respec_dangercloseimp.description: When the character engages one or more foes during combat, the character adds [SU] to their next check.

respec_deadeye.name: Dead-Eye
respec_deadeye.description: The character may benefit from a third aim maneuver on Ranged (Heavy) and Ranged (Light) attacks. It adds an additional [BO] if aiming normally, or removes an additional [SE] if aiming at a specific subset of the target.

respec_deathbeforedic.name: Death Before Discovery
respec_deathbeforedic.description: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to add [TR] to a combat check the character makes against someone who has just or is about to uncover their identity or mission.

respec_delaresp.name: Delayed Response
respec_delaresp.description: Once per session after being detected or discovered, may spend 1 Destiny Point to delay alarm, pursuit or reprisal until the end of the character's next turn.

respec_desfla.name: Design Flaw (Improved)*
respec_desfla.description: Take the Improved Design Flaw action; Make an opposed Computers vs Discipline check targeting a disabled or restrained droid, downgrading the difficulty of that check once per rank of Design Flaw the character possesses. On success, the character extracts useful information from the target’s databanks, and may spend [AD][AD] to alter information in the droid’s databanks, and/or [TR] to change a significant part of the droid’s base programming, including their loyalty and prime directive.

respec_dialedin.name: Dialed In
respec_dialedin.description: Perform the Dialed In maneuver; make an Average ([DI][DI]) Perception check to treat all Ranged (Heavy) and Ranged (Light) attacks as if their maximum range was one ranged band further until the character moves more than short range from the spot they dialed in from or the encounter ends.

respec_dialedinimp.name: Dialed In (Improved)
respec_dialedinimp.description: Once per encounter, the character may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from Dialed In to decrease the difficulty of all Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) attacks they make at Long or Extreme Range.

respec_direc.name: Directive*
respec_direc.description: Once per round as a maneuver, suffer strain no more than ranks in Directive. Upgrade the ability of the next check made by an allied droid within short range a number of times equal to strain suffered.

respec_disruptiveimp.name: Disruptive (Improved)
respec_disruptiveimp.description: Spend [AD][AD] from a Computers check or [TH][TH] when opposing a foe's computers check to add [FA] equal to the character's ranks of Disruptive to a foe's next Computers check in that system.

respec_disruptivesup.name: Disruptive (Supreme)
respec_disruptivesup.description: Once per encounter after a foe makes a check that includes a computer system the character owns or has accessed this encounter, spend a Destiny Point to have that foe reroll a number of positive dice equal to the character's ranks of Disruptive, keeping the new results.

respec_elemsupr.name: Element of Surprise
respec_elemsupr.description: May spend [TR] from checks to determine initiative to force one enemy to use the last available initiative slot this encounter.

respec_emerbulk.name: Emergency Bulkheads
respec_emerbulk.description: Once per session, when the Flagship would suffer a critical hit, may take an Emergency Bulkhead incidental; make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Education check to stop the vessel from suffering  the critical hit. If successful, the Command Ship does not suffer the Critical Hit and does not suffer any of its normal effects (but the attack that causes the critical hit still deals damage as normal).

respec_emerbypa.name: Emergency Bypass
respec_emerbypa.description: Once per encounter, when an engaged starship or vehicle suffers a critical hit, spend a Destiny Point and have the engaged starship or vehicle suffer system strain equal to the severity of that critical hit to choose a different critical hit of the same severity.

respec_emeroutf.name: Emergency Outfitting
respec_emeroutf.description: Once per session, may make an Average ([DI][DI]) Vigilance check to reveal an undisclosed piece of personal gear, and may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to produce additional equipment equal to ranks of Vigilance.

respec_enoughtoget.name: Enough to Get By
respec_enoughtoget.description: Once per encounter, suffer two strain to add [BO] equal to the character’s ranks of Knowledge (Education) to a single check they make.

respec_eure.name: EUREKA!*
respec_eure.description: Once per session, may spend strain equal to difficulty of a successful Intellect check to add a [TR] to that check.

respec_evactraining.name: Evac Training
respec_evactraining.description: The character ignores the encumbrance value of one character and their gear while carrying one or more other characters. A Game Master may determine some gear cannot be easily transported along with the carried character. The character adds [BO][BO] to Athletics and Coordination checks imposed due to carrying one or more characters.

respec_exploitweakness.name: Exploit Weakness
respec_exploitweakness.description: Add [BO][BO] to attacks made against Disoriented, Immobilized, involuntarily prone, poisoned, Staggered, or incapacitated targets. Per GM discretion, other status effects may apply such as fires, acids, or particularly debilitating critical injuries.

respec_eyesandears.name: Eyes and Ears Everywhere
respec_eyesandears.description: When in a well-populated or urban location, the character may substitute Streetwise for checks to determine initiative. The Game Master determines which locations qualify.

respec_falsetrail.name: False Trail
respec_falsetrail.description: Add [SE] per rank of False Trail to checks to investigate, scrutinize, or interrogate the character. Spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] to implicate or redirect suspicion to a specific third party known to the character. The GM may add equivalent [BO] to similar checks the character makes instead.

respec_falsetrailimp.name: False Trail (Improved)
respec_falsetrailimp.description: The character may choose to upgrade the difficulty of affected checks a number of times equal to their ranks of False Trail instead of its normal effects. Spend [DE] to describe how the character laid the trap that implicated the foe making the check.

respec_fataflaw.name: Substandard Issue
respec_fataflaw.description: Once per encounter, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception or Vigilance check to determine that enemy equipment is substandard. Enemies equal to [SU][SU] add [TH][TH] to checks using this equipment in this encounter. The character may spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have this affect all present enemies in the current scene.

respec_fearlessdiversion.name: Fearless Diversion
respec_fearlessdiversion.description: Once per session, the character may make a Hard  ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool check to draw the fire of enemies. A number of foes within medium range equal to [SU] must suffer 3 strain to attack an ally until the end of the next round. Each [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] may be spent to add [FA] to each attack targeting the character, and [TR] can be spent to determine an affected enemy cannot target anyone but the character.

respec_ficaimp.name: Field Calibration (Improved)*
respec_ficaimp.description: Once per round, may suffer 2 strain to perform Field Calibration as a maneuver.

respec_fical.name: Field Calibration*
respec_fical.description: May make an Average ([DI][DI]) Mechanics check to add [SU] to the next check made by an ally using an engaged Vessel or piece of Equipment, and may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] to extend this effect to an additional check.

respec_fighthro.name: Fight Through It!
respec_fighthro.description: Once per encounter, when an ally would exceed one of their thresholds, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check to set their wounds or strain to 1 below its threshold.

respec_figurwar.name: Figure of War
respec_figurwar.description: The Inspiring Figure incidental may be used to re-roll a failed Mass Combat check as if it were an ally's check. If a re-rolled Mass Combat check is successful, add [TR] to the check.

respec_findirec.name: Final Directive*
respec_findirec.description: Once per session, when an allied droid would be incapacitated or destroyed, may spend 1 Destiny Point to allow that droid to make an immediate maneuver, followed by an action.

respec_findstor.name: Find The Story
respec_findstor.description: Once per session, may make an Average ([DI][DI]) Perception check to identify a local compelling narrative. On success, add [SU] to all checks made to utilize that story this session.

respec_finishfight.name: Finish the Fight
respec_finishfight.description: After being successfully attacked, the character may suffer 2 strain to add damage equal to their ranks of Resilience to one hit of each attack they make before the end of their next turn.

respec_finishfightimp.name: Finish the Fight (Improved)
respec_finishfightimp.description: After activating the Finish The Fight incidental, the character also adds 10 times their ranks of Resilience to the results of any Critical Injuries they inflict before the end of their next turn.

respec_fintunimp.name: Fine Tuning (Improved)
respec_fintunimp.description: Once per encounter while engaged with or repairing a starship or vehicle, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check to increase the system strain threshold of an the vessel by a number equal to the character's ranks in Fine Tuning for the rest of the encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have that vessel recover System Strain equal to ranks in Fine Tuning.

respec_fites.name: Field Tester*
respec_fites.description: Remove [SE] per rank of Field Tester from checks made using equipment or vessels the character has repaired or improved this session.

respec_flagship.name: Flagship
respec_flagship.description: Choose one starship as their Flagship. Upgrade the ability of fear checks made by crew on the Flagship once

respec_flanspee.name: Flank Speed!
respec_flanspee.description: Once per encounter, may perform the Flank Speed! maneuver. The Flagship may perform two pilot-only maneuvers this round and the following round.

respec_flashiimp.name: Flagship (Improved)
respec_flashiimp.description: When the character performs the assist maneuver aboard their Flagship, upgrade the ability of the check once, in addition to normal effects of assistance.

respec_flipscript.name: Flip the Script
respec_flipscript.description: Once per session when a foe targets an ally within short range of the character with a social check, spend a Destiny Point to have that ally make the same check against the foe instead. This check benefits from skilled assistance from the character.

respec_foragood.name: For A Good Cause
respec_foragood.description: The legality of an item does not affect the cost when buying or selling restricted items, and the character may use Negotiation to buy and sell illegal goods.

respec_forcexpl.name: Forceful Expulsion
respec_forcexpl.description: Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computerscheck to eject another character accessing a connected system. Spend [AD][AD] from this check or on a successful Eject User check to inflict strain equal to ranks of Knowledge (Education), and spend [TR] to render the chosen character's slicer's gear or access point unusable.

respec_freerunningsup.name: Freerunning (Supreme)
respec_freerunningsup.description: When falling, the character reduces the number of range bands they fall by one. If falling less than short range, they suffer no ill effects from falling.

respec_frieever.name: I Have Friends Everywhere
respec_frieever.description: Once per session, may perform a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Streetwise check. On Success, the character chooses an NPC in the scene, or reveals a previously unknown NPC; that NPC is sympathetic to the character's cause and performs a favor for the character. This favor may be rebellious in nature and may result in legal scrutiny and consequence, but must not be obviously suicidal. The Game Master determines if an NPC cannot be considered sympathetic.

respec_fromshad.name: From the Shadows
respec_fromshad.description: While undetected by enemies, the character may use the Stealth Skill when making checks to determine initiative.

respec_getingetout.name: Get In, Get Out
respec_getingetout.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery or Stealth check to establish a previously unknown entry point to a structure or vehicle that the character and allies equal to Cunning may immediately use to infiltrate, even if it were otherwise impassable. Spend [TR] to allow stealthy exit through that point without requiring further checks.

respec_ghosmach.name: Ghost in the Machine
respec_ghosmach.description: Suffer strain up to ranks in Stealth to add an equal number of [SE] or remove an equal number of [BO] from checks to trace, locate, or identify the character while they are slicing, including physical discovery.

respec_goground.name: Go To Ground
respec_goground.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Streetwise check to establish a nearby location the character and their allies can lie low. If a base or safehouse already exists, add [SU] to checks made by the character or allies to reach it this session.

respec_greagood.name: For the Greater Good
respec_greagood.description: Once per session after being successfully attacked, the character may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Discipline check to ignore the damage and the effect of this attack until the end of the encounter after which, the character suffers the damage, and the effects of any exceeded thresholds, status effects, or critical injuries, in that order.

respec_guerillawarfare.name: Guerrila Warfare
respec_guerillawarfare.description: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point. Until the end of the next round, the characters and their allies within Medium range may disengage from an enemy or enter cover once per turn as an incidental.

respec_halfbatt.name: Half The Battle
respec_halfbatt.description: Once per session, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [SE] equal to ranks of a Knowledge skill to any check. If that check fails, add [DE] to the results. The player must state the knowledge they possess which will be their adversary’s undoing.

respec_handoff.name: Hand Off*
respec_handoff.description: Once per round, as an out-of-turn incidental, suffer 2 strain to covertly pick up or hide an engaged item that is encumbrance 1 or smaller, or exchange up to two items that are encumbrance 1 or smaller with an ally within short range. If the character is being closely watched, an opposed Perception vs. Skulduggery check can be made to notice the exchange, adding [SE][SE] to the pool.

respec_healself.name: Heal Thyself*
respec_healself.description: When performing a check to heal themselves, may substitute Resilience instead of the required skill to avoid increasing the difficulty of the check.  This includes Mechanics checks to heal cyborgs or droids, but does not apply to Resilience checks to passively heal critical injuries. Talents that affect Medicine checks still apply to this roll.

respec_heroembe.name: Embellishment (Supreme)
respec_heroembe.description: Once per session, may spend a Destiny Point to add [SU] equal to ranks of Embellishment to an ally’s check. If that ally’s Duty triggered this session, may add [TR] instead.

respec_heroiccharge.name: Heroic Charge
respec_heroiccharge.description: Once per round, the character may perform the Heroic Charge maneuver and suffer 2 strain to move to engage a character within Medium range that the character could otherwise reach.

respec_heroicchargeimp.name: Heroic Charge (Improved)
respec_heroicchargeimp.description: After making the Heroic Charge maneuver, upgrade the difficulty of all ranged attacks targeting the character once until their next turn.

respec_hidfea.name: Hidden Feature*
respec_hidfea.description: Once per session as an incidental, while the character is aboard a vessel they created or are intimately familiar with, they may activate a previously unknown minor feature of the vessel as if a Destiny Point had been spent, per GM discretion. This feature lasts until the end of the encounter. At any future point, any character may reactivate this feature by spending a Destiny point.

respec_impdetimp.name: Improvised Detonation (Improved)
respec_impdetimp.description: Reduce the difficulty of Improvised Detonation to Average ([DI][DI]) and increase damage to twice ranks in Mechanics.

respec_impdirec.name: Improved Directive*
respec_impdirec.description: Once per encounter when performing the Directive maneuver, may affect an additional allied droid per rank of Directive, and the range of Directive increases to medium.

respec_impreppat.name: Repair Patch Specialization (Improved)*
respec_impreppat.description: Once per droid per encounter, after applying a repair patch to a Droid, that droid adds [SU][AD] to the next check they make this encounter.

respec_impsurg.name: Surgeon (Improved)*
respec_impsurg.description: When performing a Medicine check, may suffer strain up to ranks of Surgeon, then choose to either remove that many [SE] or add that many [BO].

respec_inciteimp.name: Incite Distraction (Improved)
respec_inciteimp.description: While piloting in traffic, a successful Incite Distraction check reduces the handling of foes' craft within medium range by 2 until the end of the character's next turn. Spend [TR] to reduce the speed of those craft to 0.

respec_inspfigu.name: Inspiring Figure
respec_inspfigu.description: Once per session, suffer 4 strain to allow an ally within medium range to reroll a failed check.

respec_juline.name: Just Like New*
respec_juline.description: Spend a Destiny Point to treat a non-destroyed piece of equipment within medium range as if it isn’t damaged until the end of the character's next turn.

respec_keeeyeimp.name: Keen Eyed (Improved)
respec_keeeyeimp.description: Once per session, make a  Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI]) Perception or Vigilance check to add [SU] to next checks they and allies make to act on the observation. Decrease difficulty of check once per rank of Keen Eyed.

respec_killzone.name: Killzone
respec_killzone.description: Once per session when holding a defensible position, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check. On success, foes within medium range add [TH] to all checks for rounds equal to ranks of Cunning.

respec_kilzonimp.name: Killzone (Improved)
respec_kilzonimp.description: The range of Killzone is extended to long range, and foes treat the area as difficult terrain. May spend[AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to add [FA] to all affected checks as well.

respec_kingmake.name: Kingmaker
respec_kingmake.description: Once per encounter, an ally may spend [AD][AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from a social check to treat their rating in the associated characteristic as if it were 1 higher until the end of the encounter.

respec_landprov.name: The Land Provides
respec_landprov.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Survival check to fashion a low-tech solution to a current problem using nearby forageable materials. This solution or object must be approved by the GM, who may impose negative qualities like Inferior or Limited Ammo, and functions until the end of the encounter.

respec_layoftheland.name: Lay of the Land
respec_layoftheland.description: Once per session, the character may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Outer Rim) check to establish an environmental factor that they are prepared for but an enemy faction is not. For all relevant checks this encounter, the character and their allies add [AD] and the chosen faction add [TH]. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to increase the Defense rating granted by relevant cover by 1 (to a maximum of 3), and [TR] to have the enemy faction treat all relevant environments as difficult terrain.

respec_lighmood.name: Lighten the Mood
respec_lighmood.description: When recovering at the end of an encounter, may roll Average ([DI][DI]) Charm check. On Success, allies equal to Presence add [SU] to their recovery rolls. The character may spend [AD][AD] to have an affected ally add an additional [SU] to their check, and may spend [TR] to recover the same number of strain as one affected ally.

respec_logibomb.name: Logic Bomb
respec_logibomb.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Computers Check and choose a connected system or device the character has access to, and a triggering event. On success, when the event occurs, the character may immediately enact a single command of their choice to that system or have it shut down, chosen at the time of triggering.

respec_looselips.name: Loose Lips...
respec_looselips.description: Once per session, make an opposed Charm vs Cool or Deception vs Discipline check against a non-hostile NPC to glean actionable intelligence. On success, add [TR] to a check the character or an ally makes that uses this intel while acting against the target NPC's organization.

respec_madmai.name: Madcap Maintenance*
respec_madmai.description: Once per session, may reroll one check to repair or maintain. If the rerolled check succeeds, add [TR] to the next check made using the item. Otherwise, the item becomes damaged further.

respec_makidoor.name: Making A Door
respec_makidoor.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Skulduggery check to treat an explosive as if it had the Breach 1 quality when breaching a specific structure or vehicle this encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to treat it as if it had Breach 2 instead.

respec_makitcou.name: Make It Count
respec_makitcou.description: Once per round, after an enemy cripples, destroys, or inflicts a critical hit on their ship or an allied ship within short range, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [AD][AD] to the next check made by a number of allies equal to Presence.

respec_manuover.name: Manual Override
respec_manuover.description: Once per encounter while piloting a silhouette 4 or smaller starship or vehicle that has exceeded its system strain threshold, the character may make a Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI]) Coordination check to set the system strain to its threshold and set the vehicle's speed to the last speed it had before exceeding the threshold. The character may spend [AD][AD] to reduce the number that the craft’s system strain is set to by 1 for each [AD][AD] spent, and may spend [TR] to immediately take another action.

respec_martyrdo.name: Martyrdom
respec_martyrdo.description: Once per encounter after being successfully hit by an attack, may suffer 3 strain to add [DE] to the check. The [DE] result added this way do not include the [FA] result that are normally part of them, only the negative effects of the symbol.

respec_maskblas.name: Masked Blast
respec_maskblas.description: Before using explosives or otherwise making a large, noticeable, sound, the character may spend a Destiny Point to establish an even louder noise to mask it. This sound may be generated by the character, the environment, or some other source. Bystanders within earshot must make an opposed Vigilance vs Stealth check to notice the sound of the explosion.

respec_maskmove.name: Mask The Movement
respec_maskmove.description: The character may take the Mask The Movement action; Make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Deception check to cover the character’s or allies’ involvement in a crime or dissident activity. On success, authorities are misled, adding [FA] plus [FA] for each additional [SU][SU] to all checks to investigate that activity or the characters involved with it this session. The character may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to implicate a third party who is both known to both the character and to authorities. This can be accomplished by physical tampering of the crime scene, bearing false witness, spreading rumors, or a combination thereof.

respec_mastmiss.name: Master Missileer
respec_mastmiss.description: Before rolling a Guided attack, may suffer strain up to ranks of the weapon’s combat skill to upgrade the ability of the Guided roll that many times.

respec_mastrid.name: Master Rider
respec_mastrid.description: Once per turn while mounted, may suffer 2 strain to perform a Survival Check or other mount-handling action as a maneuver.

respec_mathspee.name: Match Speed
respec_mathspee.description: Once per round when an ally within close range performs the Accelerate/Decelerate, Fly/Drive, or Punch it maneuver, may suffer 2 strain to perform the same maneuver to follow that ally as an out-of-turn incidental.

respec_natureme.name: Natural Remedy
respec_natureme.description: The character may use Survival instead of Medicine to heal wounds and critical injuries by increasing the difficulty of the check once.

effects.condition: to heal wounds and critical injuries

respec_needtoknowre.name: Need to Know
respec_needtoknowre.description: Once per encounter, when making a Leadership skill check, the character may use Deception instead of Leadership. The character's Deception skill is combined with their Presence Characteristic to form the dice pool.

respec_nolooseendsre.name: No Loose Ends
respec_nolooseendsre.description: Once per session when making a check that utilizes an intelligence or contact network, spend a Destiny Point to remove [SE] equal to the character's ranks of Willpower, or to have a failed check succeed as if a single [SU] had been the result. If they do, reduce the intelligence network by one member or the contact network's scope by one.

respec_ofmanyfaces.name: Of Many Faces
respec_ofmanyfaces.description: At the beginning of each session, choose one unranked skill in which the character possesses no ranks to gain two temporary ranks, or two unranked skills to gain one rank each. This effect lasts until at the end of the session.

respec_oneshotonekill.name: One Shot, One Kill
respec_oneshotonekill.description: Ranged (Heavy) and Ranged (Light) attacks the character makes gain +2 Pierce for each aim maneuver they are benefiting from.

respec_onlook.name: On The Lookout
respec_onlook.description: When making a check to determine initiative, spend a Destiny point to add [SU] to both their check and to a number of allies' equal to ranks in Cunning.

respec_outflank.name: Outflank
respec_outflank.description: Once per encounter, the character may perform a move maneuver as an incidental, then choose an enemy within range of an equipped weapon. Remove [SE][SE] from next attack the character makes against the chosen enemy this turn. This cannot allow the character to perform more than two maneuvers to move in a turn.

respec_ovbatt.name: Overcharged Battery*
respec_ovbatt.description: Once per round while piloting or operating a starship, before the character or an ally makes a Gunnery check, may have the starship suffer 2 system strain to increase the damage of the attack by 2 or reduce the Critical Rating by 1 (minimum of 1).

respec_overkill.name: Overkill
respec_overkill.description: Once per attack when the character causes a foe to exceed their wound threshold, suffer 2 strain to assign a hit dealing damage equal to the amount exceeding that threshold to another target within short range of the first.

respec_overstocked.name: Overstocked
respec_overstocked.description: When purchasing personal equipment, the character may suffer 2 strain to gain an additional unit of that kind of equipment at 50% of its final unit price. The GM may determine what is personal gear, but it could range from weapons and explosives to small speeder bikes.

respec_overwatchre.name: Overwatch
respec_overwatchre.description: Once per encounter, before a foe moves or acts, may make an opposed Cool vs Vigilance check against that foe, adding any relevant [BO] due to aiming. On success, they suffer a hit from an equipped ranged weapon with the appropriate range to attack the target plus 1 Damage per [SU]. The character may spend [AD] or [TR] results to inflict Critical Injuries and activate weapon qualities.

respec_packagesec.name: Package Secured
respec_packagesec.description: Once per session when a valuable carried item is at imminent risk of being lost, stolen or discovered, spend a Destiny Point to add [TR] or [DE] to any one check related to maintaining control of the object.

respec_permai.name: Percussive Maintenance*
respec_permai.description: Once per encounter as a maneuver, before making a check to repair or damage an engaged machine, starship, vehicle, or droid, suffer 2 wounds to add [BO] equal to the character's ranks of Melee or Brawl (whichever is higher) to the check.

respec_plainsight.name: In Plain Sight
respec_plainsight.description: Once per session, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Streetwise check. On success, add [SU] to all checks the character makes to avoid scrutiny or identification, and [FA] to all checks made to identify or scrutinize the character this encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to extend these benefits to allies while they remain within short range.

respec_plamaisys.name: Planned Maintenance System
respec_plamaisys.description: Repairs made to Signature Vehicle cost 25% less per rank of Planned Maintenance System, rounded down.

respec_planswithinplansimp.name: Plans Within Plans (Improved)
respec_planswithinplansimp.description: Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] from Plans Within Plans to choose to add [SU] or [FA] to checks affected by Plans Within Plans after they are rolled, but after results are determined, rather than before.

respec_planswithinplansre.name: Plans Within Plans
respec_planswithinplansre.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Warfare) or Streetwise check to establish a previously unknown covert plan that is coming to fruition during this encounter. Add [SU] or [FA] to one plan-related made during this encounter, plus one check for each [SU][SU] past the first.

respec_portcall.name: Port of Call
respec_portcall.description: The Flagship has a dockyard, station, or other location they call home. Add [SU][AD] to all checks made to repair or resupply the Flagship at the Port of Call. If the Port of Call is ever conquered or closed to the character, a new Port of Call may be selected by making a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Core World), (Outer Rim), (Underworld), or (Warfare) check, depending on the nature of the location, and must be properly equipped and prepared, the time required for which is determined by the GM.

respec_potenttinc.name: Potent Tinctures
respec_potenttinc.description: Foes upgrade the difficulty of checks made to resist the effects of poisons that were created or administered by the character once per rank of Potent Tinctures.

respec_powerfulstims.name: Powerful Stims
respec_powerfulstims.description: Once per encounter after administering a stim or stimpack, the character may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [SU] to each check made by the character who received the stim or stimpack until the end of the encounter.

respec_quicpick.name: Quick Pickup
respec_quicpick.description: Once per encounter while piloting a starship or vehicle, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Piloting check to have any number of allies within medium range of the craft board it as an out-of-turn incidental.

respec_readroom.name: Read The Room
respec_readroom.description: Once per encounter, may make an Average ([DI][DI]) Vigilance check. On success, gain social insight into one character per [SU], and spend [AD][AD] to add [BO] to all social checks made by you and allies targeting one of those characters. For each character, the player learns which social skill will be most effective against them, or which social skill they are most likely to employ, but not both.

respec_readwind.name: Read The Wind
respec_readwind.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check. On success, a moderate ([SE][SE]) environmental effect appears. Spend [TR] for a severe ([SE][SE][SE]) environmental effect. This hazard could be weather, man-made actions, or natural disasters.

respec_reawinimp.name: Read the Wind (Improved)
respec_reawinimp.description: May suffer 2 strain to perform the Read The Wind action as a maneuver.

respec_reckrepo.name: Reckless Reposition
respec_reckrepo.description: Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Astrogation check. On success, before a foe begins their turn or makes an attack, the character may have their vessel suffer system strain equal to its silhouette to microjump away as an out-of-turn incidental. At the beginning of the character's next turn, they may jump again to return no closer than long range from the original location as an incidental. The game Master may spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from the check to choose the final location of the vessel instead.

respec_recrepimp.name: Reckless Reposition (Improved)
respec_recrepimp.description: May spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from Reckless Reposition to allow a close-range allied ship to jump with them, which may choose to stay outside the fight, or return with them.

respec_respkind.name: Respond In Kind
respec_respkind.description: May spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] from an incoming social check to add [SU][AD] to the next Charm, Negotiation, or Leadership check the character or an ally makes targeting that adversary.

respec_retufire.name: Return Fire!
respec_retufire.description: Once per round, when an enemy incapacitates or inflicts a critical injury upon an ally within short range, suffer 3 strain to inflict a hit on that enemy with an equipped weapon.

respec_reveg.name: Reverse Engineering*
respec_reveg.description: Once per session, the character may spend credits and make a Knowledge (Education) or Mechanics check to create an identical copy of a piece of personal gear the character has access to. The difficulty of this check is equal to half the rarity of the item, rounded down, and the time required is 2 hours times the difficulty. The credit cost of this process is equal to half of the item's base price.

respec_riddow.name: Ride Down
respec_riddow.description: While mounted, the mount’s Brawl attacks and any rider’s melee attacks deal additional damage equal to the speed of the mount.

respec_righange.name: Righteous Anger
respec_righange.description: The character may suffer 2 strain to make a Leadership check with Willpower instead of Presence.

respec_roadlesstraveled.name: Road Less Traveled
respec_roadlesstraveled.description: Once per session, the character may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception or Survival check to establish a temporary shortcut between their present location and a location within Extreme range. As long as they stay on the shortcut, maneuvers the character and allies make to move directly towards the end location may move twice the distance this encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to add [SU] to all Stealth checks made by those on the path.

respec_settone.name: Set The Tone
respec_settone.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Negotiation check, and choose two social skills. Decrease the difficulty (minimum Easy ([DI])) of all checks made by others using the first and increase those using the second this encounter.

respec_shadsecr.name: Shadowfeed Secret
respec_shadsecr.description: Once per session, may choose target location or faction, or person and make a Knowledge (Underworld) check with a difficulty based on the target. On [SU], may add [TR] to a Computers check to slice that target this session.

respec_shinarimp.name: Shift The Narrative (Improved)
respec_shinarimp.description: When taking the Shift The Narrative action, may spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to increase or decrease the difficulty of the first check members of the targeted organization make each encounter this session.

respec_shinarsup.name: Shift The Narrative (Supreme)
respec_shinarsup.description: The group affected by Shift The Narrative increases or decreases their wound threshold by 1, plus an additional 1 for each additional [SU][SU][SU] until the end of the session.

respec_sigvehimp.name: Signature Vehicle (Improved)
respec_sigvehimp.description: The character’s Signature Vehicle may have a silhouette or 5 or less. Increase the character’s Signature Vehicle's top speed by 1, to a maximum of speed 6.

respec_sigvehsup.name: Signature Vehicle (Supreme)
respec_sigvehsup.description: Once per session, may spend 1 Destiny Point to add [TR] to a check involving the Signature Vehicle as an out-of-turn incidental.

respec_silenttake.name: Silent Takedown
respec_silenttake.description: When the character incapacitates a foe with an attack, they may suffer 2 strain to do so silently and immediately conceal the evidence of the attack, per GM discretion. A character must make an opposed Vigilance vs Stealth check to discover the attack.

respec_sinkships.name: ...Sink Ships
respec_sinkships.description: After the character successfully takes the …Loose Lips action, they may choose to add [DE] to a  check relevant to the intel made by the target NPC’s organization instead of adding [TR].

respec_sleeperactivate.name: Sleeper Activate
respec_sleeperactivate.description: Once per session when voluntarily abandoning a cover story, façade or persona, as an incidental, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool or Discipline check. On Success, add [SU] to all checks the character makes this encounter. Spend [TR] to reduce the difficulty of those checks once instead.

respec_sme.name: Subject Matter Expert
respec_sme.description: Once per encounter, may spend 1 Destiny point to add [BO][BO][BO] to any check the character makes to which their personal experience is relevant.

respec_somereal.name: Something More Real
respec_somereal.description: Spend 1 Destiny Point when negotiating the cost of goods or services to introduce physical goods to be bartered, counting the value of those goods at 125% of their current value, instead of or in addition to credits. Modify the check based on legality and the item's level of damage.

respec_soreimp.name: Solid Repairs (Improved)
respec_soreimp.description: Once per encounter, the character may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Mechanics check to increase the armor of an engaged starship or vehicle by 1 until the end of the encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to have that vessel recover hull trauma equal to the character's ranks of Solid Repairs.

respec_sparebimp.name: Spark of Rebellion (Improved)
respec_sparebimp.description: Double the number of characters affected by Spark of Rebellion. Spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to affect all rebel-sympathetic characters instead.

respec_sterment.name: Stern Mentor
respec_sterment.description: Once per Encounter, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion check. On success, allies equal to Willpower rating may suffer 2 strain and decrease the difficulty of their next check once.

respec_subterfuge.name: Subterfuge
respec_subterfuge.description: Once per session, make an opposed Deception check against a foe within short range to draw them in or lower their guard. On success, add [TR] to the next combat check the character makes against the foe before the end of the character’s next turn. Outside of structured time, this attack may be made immediately.

respec_supfirimp.name: Suppressing Fire (Improved)
respec_supfirimp.description: Foes who suffer strain from the effects of the character’s Suppressing Fire and foes within short range of the targeted character upgrade the difficulty of their next check once.

respec_sustfire.name: Sustained Fire
respec_sustfire.description: When performing an Aim maneuver, if the character successfully attacked the target this or last round, upgrade the ability of that attack instead of the aim’s normal effects (cannot be used to target a specific item or part of the target).

respec_synth.name: Synthesis*
respec_synth.description: Once per encounter, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Medicine check to create a chemical equivalent to any medical supply or chemical compound with a rarity of Intellect + [SU] or lower. The character may spend [AD][AD] to create an additional unit per [AD][AD] spent.

respec_takefew.name: Take A Few With Us
respec_takefew.description: When aboard the Flagship, Fire Discipline affects twice the number of attacks, and those attacks reduce their critical rating by 1, (minimum of 1). When the Flagship has suffered hull trauma greater than half of its threshold, attacks made by it gain Breach +1.

respec_tecbab.name: Technobabble*
respec_tecbab.description: Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Education) check to establish a fact that solves a current problem.

respec_thoassimp.name: Thorough Assessment (Improved)
respec_thoassimp.description: When distributing a [BO] from Thorough Assessment, may choose to distribute a [SU] instead.

respec_tightgroup.name: Tight Grouping
respec_tightgroup.description: After making a Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) attack while aiming, if there is a foe within short range of the original target, or the original target isn't defeated, the character may suffer strain up to the number of aims the attack was benefiting from to aim that many times as an incidental.

respec_timesplitter.name: Time-Splitter
respec_timesplitter.description: Once per encounter, the character may perform the Time-Splitter maneuver to ignore a weapon's Slow-Firing quality this turn and upgrade the difficulty of the next check using it equal to its ranks of Slow-Firing. This may also allow the character to use a weapon that has already been fired this round by upgrading the difficulty of that attack equal to the number of times it has been fired this round.

respec_toolrebe.name: Tools of Rebellion
respec_toolrebe.description: Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Underworld) or Knowledge (Warfare) check. On Success, an amount of weapons and equipment suitable to outfit allies equal to [SU] is covertly stashed nearby.

respec_trigdisc.name: Trigger Discipline
respec_trigdisc.description: When making a ranged attack, the character may suffer 2 strain to remove a number of [BO] up ranks of Discipline from the dice pool, adding [AD] to the pool for each removed this way.

respec_unaurequ.name: Unauthorized Requisition
respec_unaurequ.description: Once per session, may make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Underworld) check to establish ill-gotten munitions or equipment in their ship or base, with a cost no greater than 250 credits per rank of Knowledge (Society). The item(s) must be contraband or stolen.

respec_underada.name: Under The Radar
respec_underada.description: While their vessel is in difficult terrain, or is otherwise able to be obscured from enemies, the character may take the Under the Radar action to reduce the emissions of theirs and allied vessels at close range. For rounds equal to the character's Intellect rating, the character's vessel and allied vessels within close range go undetected by foes unless a foe makes an opposed Perception vs Computers (Sysops) check, adding [BO] to the check for each ally included. Any vessel that exceeds speed 1, attacks, or engages in excessive systems use ends this effect for that vessel.

respec_unitpeop.name: Uniter of People
respec_unitpeop.description: Once per session, may choose a faction or group and make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm or Negotiation check. On success, allied characters and the chosen faction within medium range add [AD] to skill checks this encounter. The character may spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to decrease the difficulty of all affected characters’ next check.

respec_universalrelief.name: Universal Relief
respec_universalrelief.description: Once per session, choose a species and make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Knowledge (Xenology) check. On success, the character adds [AD][AD] to the first check they make or assist with to interact with or heal each member of that species this session.

respec_unquauth.name: Unquestioned Authority
respec_unquauth.description: Remove [SE] from Coercion and Leadership checks equal to ranks of Unquestioned Authority.

respec_unwittingaccomplice.name: Unwitting Accomplice
respec_unwittingaccomplice.description: Once per session while undercover, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Charm or Deception check to have a character in the scene, or one that conveniently appears, vouch for the character’s cover story. That character provides assistance on social checks for the remainder of the scene, per GM discretion.

respec_usertalent2.name: Reverse Engineering (Improved)*
respec_usertalent2.description: May scrap the original item instead of paying credits when taking the Reverse Engineering action. May also spend [TR] to grant the item the Superior quality at the cost of one Hard Point or 0 Hard Points if the item doesn't have Hard Points. If this item is not a weapon or armor, it gains a narrative benefit chosen by the Game Master and the Player.

respec_veiledthreats.name: Veiled Threats
respec_veiledthreats.description: Make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Coercion or Deception check to upgrade the difficulty of the next check made by foes equal to Cunning. Spend [TR] to upgrade one of those foe's checks once for the rest of the encounter instead.

respec_waridea.name: War of Ideas
respec_waridea.description:
When a foe makes a social check to persuade a third party, may suffer strain up to ranks of Knowledge (Warfare) to add that many [SE] to the check. If it fails, upgrade the ability of all social checks targeting that party or the foe once for the remainder of the session.
Multiple uses of this talent are not cumulative, this talent only ever upgrades those checks once.

respec_weapfree.name: Weapons Free
respec_weapfree.description: Once per encounter, as a maneuver, may ignore a weapon’s Slow-Firing quality this turn and upgrade the difficulty of the next check using it equal to its ranks of Slow-Firing.

respec_wellsupimp.name: Well-Supplied (Improved)
respec_wellsupimp.description: When activating Well-Supplied, increase the affected ally's strain threshold by 2 until the end of the encounter. Each ally may only benefit from this once per encounter.

respec_wellsupp.name: Well-Supplied
respec_wellsupp.description: Once per round when an ally attempts a skill check, may spend 25 credits times the difficulty of the check to add [SU] to that check. This talent may also be used on an allied Mass Combat check by spending 250 credits times the difficulty of the check, as determined by the size of the opposing force.

respec_whereithurts.name: Where It Hurts
respec_whereithurts.description: Once per encounter, make a Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Perception check and choose a foe within long range. On success, the character's attack gains Pierce equal to Cunning against that target until the end of the encounter. Spend [AD][AD][AD][AD] or [TR] to immediately take another action.

respec_wilyride.name: Wily Rider
respec_wilyride.description: Count mounted animals as having a silhouette as 1 lower when being attacked. Minimum of 0.

respec_wingcomm.name: Wing Commander
respec_wingcomm.description: While piloting a starship or vehicle, the character and allies within close range may spend [AD][AD] or [TR] from checks to determine initiative to perform a pilot-only maneuver as an out of turn incidental.

respec_wrangle.name: Wrangle
respec_wrangle.description: Once per round, the character may suffer strain up to ranks in Athletics and perform the Wrangle maneuver. An animal or foe within short range adds [SE] equal to strain suffered to their next action and treats their surroundings as difficult terrain until the character’s next turn. [TH][TH] from checks made by the wrangled foe while wrangled may be spent to knock the foe prone, and [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] may be spent to Immobilize them for rounds equal to the character's ranks of Athletics. The character must have rope or a similarly-functioning item or short-range melee weapon to perform the Wrangle maneuver.
